verdicts.explanation: The Conclusions give 6×10-5 – 3×10-4 S cm-1 at 300 K for pure Li6PS5Cl, matching Table 2's 'This work (NEMD)' entry. The value is an extrapolation from 600/800 K data, which the record's notes already state, and all secondary fields are null.
Section 3.3.3 gives 6×10-3 – 1×10-1 S cm-1 for the S-Cl disordered Li6PS5Cl, and Table 2 labels it 'This work (EMD)' at 300 K. The material, origin and temperature are all correct.

Section 3.3.3 states that the Li5.75PS4.75Cl1.25 structure has 0.09 ± 0.03 S cm-1 at 300 K, calculated in this work. The computational origin and the temperature are correct, and the secondary fields are null.

The Introduction says Li6PS5Cl 'is reported to have a conductivity of ~10-3 S cm-1 at room temperature' citing refs 24-25, so it is a literature value. The record correctly marks it literature_cited with a null numeric temperature.

The 1.1×10-3 S cm-1 value is explicitly attributed to ref. 48, so literature_cited is correct. Table 2's caption gives the temperature as 300 K for all entries, including the Li5.6PS4.8Cl1.2 experimental value from ref. 48, so the 300 K temperature is supported.
